results.name: Wildfire in Portugal
results.reason: Since 27th July, the number of wildfires in Portugal had continued to increase, with 60 active incidents reported. Three of these fires had been burning for over 24 hours. Due to the persistence of the fires in Arouca, Ponte da Barca and Vila Real, EMS Copernicus activation was requested. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide fire extent and monitoring.
